adversary_model: Importer receives a genuine or plausible live counterparty artifact, stages it under examples/artifacts for convenience, and then packages the public handoff zip before anyone notices.
facts_supplied: ledger may still show sha256 and immutable copy
payload path is inside the public archive tree
release packager traverses the archive root
hidden_trap_summary: The chain of custody appears strong while the confidentiality boundary has already failed by putting raw bytes in the public release path.
expected_safe_behavior: fail package_release before writing the bundle
require private-vault:// locator for live-candidate drops
keep live floor at zero until downstream gates pass
unacceptable_behavior: treat examples/artifacts as acceptable custody for live candidates
redact after packaging rather than blocking before packaging
count the staged bytes as a receipt
measurement_method: vault_release_guard scans release-tree payloads and live-candidate ledgers before packaging; audit_private_evidence_vault_split runs a synthetic external-vault staging test.
